description:
Station Refitting

Goes well with Station Augments!

CAN BE ADDED AND REMOVED FROM SAVES AT WILL

About

Enables station refitting. Variants save across upgrades, damage, and are only lost if the station is deconstructed.

Additionally, autogenerates OP costs for stations, even modded. Hullmod blacklists are also in place, to prevent things getting *too* silly.

Compatibility

Can be added and removed at will.

FAQ

How do I use this mod? To refit your station, click your orbital station industry and then the refit button. Everything after that, save for officer assignments, are the same as vanilla.

Does the AI use this? The AI has always fitted their stations. This changes nothing about their behavior in this regard.

Does this make stations overpowered? Yes, in the same way allowing you to refit your ships makes them overpowered.

I thought stations were never meant to be refitted. Yes. It cannot be denied. Therefore, before going into this mod, prepare to see floating mounts, strange weapon layouts, and experience lofty balance. I can only go so far with fixing these issues.

Does this work with X mod? As long as the station subtypes Orbital Station, and I have added its modules into my OP autogen CSV, it will allow you to refit, and have a sensible OP limit.

How is station OP calculated? I take the highest OP-cost variant that applies to this module, multiply it against a small constant, and use that. That extra bit is because, in vanilla, stations like to use their near-infinite OP to add hullmods.

Download: https://github.com/nikothedude/Station-Refitting/releases/

Repo: https://github.com/nikothedude/Station-Refitting

Buy me a ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/nikotheguydude

Changelog
1.0.0
Release

Autogenerated OP now rounds to the nearest multiple of 5

Enables refitting if the station is dead
Added a tip

Blacklists a few more hullmods
Fixes goathead, XIII

0.2.1

REALLY fixes fleet deflation

0.2.0

Fixes high tech attack modules having lots of OP

Fixes saving the game discarding your changes

Added a hullmod blacklist to stations

0.1.0

Stations now automatically generate their OP based on variants

Added a lunasetting for increasing/decreasing station OP

0.0.0
